article_title: Vaping: Why people who have never smoked are getting hooked

tasks.prompt: What is the article's central question?
options: Why growing numbers of people who never smoked are vaping, what keeps them dependent and how policy and cessation support are responding
Why cigarette smoking has increased among every UK age group
Whether all nicotine products should be prescribed by doctors
How disposable vapes are manufactured outside Britain
tasks.correct_answer: Why growing numbers of people who never smoked are vaping, what keeps them dependent and how policy and cessation support are responding
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה בוחנת מדוע מי שלא עישנו מתחילים לאדות, כיצד תלות חברתית, התנהגותית וניקוטינית מתפתחת, ומה נעשה בנושא.

tasks.prompt: According to the ONS data cited, roughly how many UK vapers say they have never smoked?
options: About 110,000
More than one million
Nearly five million children
Exactly 45% of all adults
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי נתוני ONS, יותר ממיליון בני אדם בבריטניה אומרים שמעולם לא עישנו אך הם מאדים.

tasks.prompt: What does “psychological dependence” mean in Dr Helen Wall's explanation?
options: A legal requirement to buy nicotine
A learned emotional or behavioural reliance on vaping
A lung disease caused only by cigarettes
A temporary dislike of vape flavours
tasks.correct_answer: A learned emotional or behavioural reliance on vaping
tasks.explanation_hebrew: psychological dependence היא תלות רגשית או התנהגותית, למשל שימוש באידוי כדי לווסת חרדה או כפעולה אוטומטית.

tasks.prompt: Which age group does the ONS report suggest is most likely to vape?
options: Under-16s
People aged 18-24
People aged 25-34
People over 75
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הדוח מצביע על בני 25–34 כקבוצה בעלת שיעור האידוי הגבוה ביותר, כמעט אחד מכל שישה.

tasks.prompt: Why does Prof Sarah Jackson describe the rise in never-smoker vaping as a mixed picture?
options: Some users may have avoided more harmful smoking, while others may be exposed to nicotine risk they would otherwise not face.
Vaping is more harmful than smoking for every user.
The ONS counted only people who had quit nicotine completely.
Marketing affects smokers but cannot influence never-smokers.
tasks.correct_answer: Some users may have avoided more harmful smoking, while others may be exposed to nicotine risk they would otherwise not face.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ג׳קסון מציגה שני צדדים: ייתכן שאידוי מנע מעישון אצל חלק מהאנשים, אך אחרים התחילו להשתמש בניקוטין בלי שהיו מעשנים.

tasks.prompt: What does Gracey mean when she calls vaping a “mindless action”?
options: It requires careful planning each time.
It has become automatic and happens without conscious thought.
It is permitted only while using social media.
It no longer contains nicotine.
tasks.correct_answer: It has become automatic and happens without conscious thought.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: mindless action היא פעולה אוטומטית שנעשית כמעט בלי מחשבה, כפי שגרייסי החזיקה בוייפ בזמן גלילה בטלפון.

tasks.prompt: What social, emotional and marketing factors does the article link to never-smokers starting or continuing to vape?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין נורמליזציה בקרב חברים, חרדה ולחץ, ההרגל הפיזי והדופמין, וכן צבעים, טעמים ושיווק שיוצרים רושם שהמוצר בטוח.
expected_points: Frequent exposure among classmates can make vaping seem normal and encourage experimentation.
Some people use the hand-to-mouth action to cope with social anxiety, stress or a break-up.
The repeated action and nicotine reward can become habitual and tied to activities such as doomscrolling.
Bright colours, sweet flavours and prominent marketing may attract users and create the misconception that vaping is safe and non-addictive.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the evidence and uncertainty about the public-health impact of vaping among never-smokers.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג את העלייה במספר המאדים שמעולם לא עישנו, את העובדה שאידוי פחות מזיק מסיגריות אך ממכר ולא ידוע לטווח ארוך, ואת האפשרות למניעת עישון מול יצירת סיכון חדש.
expected_points: More than one million UK vapers report never having smoked, and the number is rising.
Nicotine is highly addictive; vaping is less harmful than cigarettes, but its long-term effects remain unclear.
Some people may have vaped instead of beginning to smoke, which would reduce harm.
Research showing nicotine use rising while smoking falls suggests that some vapers would not otherwise have used nicotine.

tasks.prompt: Why might the original quit-smoking message about vaping fail to protect never-smokers?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר שהמסר 'פחות מזיק מסיגריות' עלול להתפרש כבטוח, שהשיווק והקבלה החברתית מרחיבים את הקהל, ושאין מספיק מסר ותמיכה למי שהתחילו ישירות בוייפ.
expected_points: A relative-risk message for smokers can be misunderstood as meaning that vaping is harmless.
Attractive flavours, colours and social acceptance can reach people who were never trying to quit cigarettes.
Nicotine dependence can develop through both chemical withdrawal and repeated emotional or physical habits.
Public services and messaging were designed mainly around replacing cigarettes, leaving direct-to-vape users with less tailored support.

tasks.prompt: Write a balanced public-health recommendation for reducing vaping among never-smokers without discouraging smokers from quitting cigarettes.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להבחין בין מעשנים ללא־מעשנים, להבהיר סיכון יחסי וממכרות, לצמצם שיווק לצעירים, ולשפר תמיכה בגמילה מאידוי תוך שמירה על מסלולי גמילה מעישון.
expected_points: Clearly state that non-smokers and under-18s should not vape, while smokers should receive evidence-based help to stop cigarettes.
Explain that vaping is less harmful than smoking but is addictive and not risk-free.
Reduce youth-oriented appeal through marketing, packaging and flavour rules while preserving appropriate cessation pathways for smokers.
Expand vaping-cessation support, including gradual nicotine reduction, longer intervals between sessions and suitable nicotine replacement therapy.
